title: City Confirms Election Results Swiftly
summary:
*   A special session was convened to specifically address the recent municipal election outcomes.
*   The official results from the May 4, 1996 General Municipal Election were reviewed and formally approved.
*   The decision to validate the election results passed with a unanimous 6-0 vote from attending members.
*   The meeting was exceptionally brief, concluding shortly after the single agenda item was addressed.
